description: Read-only: choose exactly one title from an ordered 2–12 game backlog and return the selected game, session length, mood, language, and a ready-to-follow time-boxed instruction. It never launches, buys, installs, modifies, or accesses a game or account. Use quick to start immediately, focus for one clear objective, chill for low-pressure play, or challenge for a difficult but reachable objective. The same seed plus the same ordered games list selects the same game; omit seed for a fresh random choice. No account, store login, or payment is required. Game titles and seed are processed in memory and are not stored; only an aggregate request event is recorded.

inputSchema.description: Inputs for selecting one game and generating a bounded play session. Game titles and the optional seed are processed in memory and are not stored.

games.description: Ordered list of 2–12 distinct game titles to choose from. Order matters when seed is supplied.

items.description: A game title, trimmed to 1–80 characters.

lang.description: Language of the generated instruction: en for English or ru for Russian. Defaults to en.

minutes.description: Length of the play session in minutes. Defaults to 60.

mood.description: Quest style: quick starts immediately, focus picks one clear objective, chill avoids progress pressure, and challenge asks for a difficult but reachable objective. Defaults to focus.

seed.description: Optional repeatability key, up to 64 characters. The same seed plus the same normalized ordered games list selects the same game; omit it for a fresh cryptographically random choice.

name: create_backlog_quest

outputSchema.description: A generated backlog quest plus privacy and follow-up links.

human_url.description: Browser version of Backlog Quest with machine-source attribution.

privacy.description: How request data and aggregate measurement are handled.

quest.description: The selected game and the bounded play instruction.

minutes.description: The requested session length in minutes.
